title: BeSpoke cumulative visual design selection (v2)
description: Generated by scripts/generate-selection-v2-schema.mjs. Catalog validation and advisory-only contrast guidance use builder-model.mjs. Legacy selection is preserved verbatim and validated by the original v1 authority.

date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) used for submission folder naming.

id.description: Lesson slug without the lesson- prefix; FID-2 normalizes to lesson-<id> for registries.

legacySelection.title: Bespoke selection (bespoke-selection/v1)
legacySelection.description: Machine-readable Bespoke wizard payload. Enums are generated from SPOKES Builder/bespoke-library-catalog.json and bespoke/catalog.json by scripts/generate-selection-schema.py — do not hand-edit enums.

submittedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp from the browser at submit time.

date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) used for submission folder naming.

libraryCatalogVersion.description: Expected to match library catalog version ('1.0.0' at generation).

id.description: Lesson slug without the lesson- prefix; FID-2 normalizes to lesson-<id> for registries.

catalogIds.description: UI keys {family}.{slug} for builder footnotes; not used by registry apply.

brief.description: Design brief answers that produced the starting design. variant is a digit string so the payload keeps no numeric fields.

customChecks: lesson.id must be a kebab-case slug (no lesson- prefix required)
when theme.cards.varyByChapter is true, chapterStyles must include every chapter key
libraryCatalogVersion should match the committed library catalog version
when varying cards, adjacent chapters must use different styles
